Given the verification information, register a seller to a marketplace.

When the seller must complete additional verification the API responds
with a 451 containing a `verificationLink`. Send the seller there; once
they finish, they are returned to `body.redirectUrl` when supplied, and
otherwise to the marketplace's Coinflow seller login page.
